# The manifest probe (probe_manifest.c), built with xsdk in WSL:
#   cmake -S tools/probe_manifest -B build/probe_manifest -G Ninja -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=<xsdk>/cmake/xsdk.cmake
# build.sh does this.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(probe_manifest C ASM)

# The probe's own kernel imports, as thunks generated by xsdk's tool (as Avatar Thrift Store's app does).
file(STRINGS imports.txt import_lines REGEX "^[^#].*[^ ]")
set(import_sources)
foreach(line IN LISTS import_lines)
    string(REGEX REPLACE "^[^ ]+ +[^ ]+ +([^ ]+).*" "\\1" name "${line}")
    list(APPEND import_sources "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/imports/${name}.S")
endforeach()
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${import_sources}
    COMMAND python3 "${XSDK_ROOT}/tools/gen_imports.py" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/imports.txt"
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/imports"
    DEPENDS imports.txt "${XSDK_ROOT}/tools/gen_imports.py"
    VERBATIM)

add_executable(probe_manifest probe_manifest.c ${import_sources})
target_compile_options(probe_manifest PRIVATE -std=gnu17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra)
xsdk_add_xex(probe_manifest)
